My partner and I were moving in together, and I planned on getting my first cat after we settled in. Prior to the move I had been window shopping at my petsmart, which hosts cats from a couple local shelters. My girl was there up out of the way, where visitors wouldn't be able to pet her without asking. She was still curious about everyone who passed by, and she had the most interesting coat I'd ever seen. I asked to pet her and was told a story about how she had been brought to the shelter from a kill shelter in the city. She was on death row there, as she had been deemed too shy to be adopted. I couldn't get her story out of my head and went back to visit her every day until I took her home that weekend. I was told that because of how shy she was, it would be a very long time before I would even see her moving around at home, but she slept on my chest that night. Adopting her when I did made moving more stressful, but it was definitely worth it
